researchNotes: Official shop (maisonasrar.com/collections/all) lists 132 items over 11 pages; room sprays, reed diffusers and gift sets were excluded, leaving 114 fragrances. The shop shows only three headline notes per fragrance (stored as flat, no pyramid); concentration is not shown on listings so it is null. Brand country not stated on the About page (storefront defaults to UAE/AED) so null. BJ Distribuzione page returned empty content. Several official product URLs use a gulf-orchid- prefix (Flair, Gold Noir, Masterpiece, Rose, Silver Elixer, Timeless), indicating a link to Gulf Orchid; a search summary also called Maison Asrar part of the Gulf Orchid group, not independently confirmed.

fragrances.name: Alonoud

sources.name: The Scent Base — Maison Asrar Alonoud

fragrances.performanceEvidence: The Scent Base listing: longevity around 6-10 hours (score 4.2). Sillage is marked 'not rated yet', so no level is set; ratings are provisional.

fragrances.name: Ameer
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review: 'exceeding 8-10 hours on skin'; 'strong sillage'. Same review rates fall and winter best, spring OK, summer to avoid; suits evening events.

fragrances.name: Aseel
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review: '8+ hours' longevity, detectable on fabric the next day; projection 'moderate to strong' at arm's length. Best for cool-weather evenings and formal wear.

fragrances.name: Belgravia

sources.name: Vivir — Maison Asrar Bel Gravia review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review: '7-8 hours on skin'; sillage 'strong to enormous'. Spring and summer best, fall and winter OK; daytime social events.

fragrances.name: Dubai London

sources.name: Vivir — Maison Asrar Dubai London review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review: '6-8 hours' longevity; projection moderate, within arm's length. Described as good for fall and winter.

fragrances.name: Dubai Miami

sources.name: Vivir — Maison Asrar Dubai Miami review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review: '7-9 hours'; sillage moderate to strong for the first 2-3 hours, then a skin scent. Spring and summer best, fall OK, winter to avoid.

fragrances.name: Dubai Milano

sources.name: Vivir — Maison Asrar Dubai Milano review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review: '8+ hours'; strong initial projection, then sillage moderate to strong. Described as suited to summer and fall evenings.

fragrances.name: DXB Jumeirah

sources.name: Vivir — Maison Asrar DXB Jumeirah review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review: 'lasting 8-10 hours on skin'; strong sillage with aggressive projection for the first 2-3 hours. Spring and summer best, fall acceptable, winter to avoid.

fragrances.name: Flair

sources.name: The Scent Base — Maison Asrar Flair

fragrances.performanceEvidence: The Scent Base listing: longevity around 6-10 hours (score 4.2). Sillage is not rated by the community yet, so no level is set; based on very few votes.

fragrances.name: Hamsat Ghazal

sources.name: The Scent Base — Maison Asrar Hamsat Ghazal

fragrances.performanceEvidence: The Scent Base listing: long-lasting, 8+ hours, and 'Good Projection'. No sillage score is given and no written reviews exist yet.

fragrances.name: Heritage

sources.name: The Scent Base — Maison Asrar Heritage

fragrances.performanceEvidence: The Scent Base listing: 'Above Average 6+ hours' longevity and 'Good Projection'. Based on few or no user reviews.

fragrances.name: Hikaya
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review: '8+ hours' longevity; sillage strong (a second passage in the same review says moderate to strong). Fall and winter best; cool-weather evenings.

fragrances.name: Infina
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review: 6-8 hours on skin, a preliminary estimate (the brand claims exceptional longevity); sillage moderate. Spring and summer best, fall and winter OK.

fragrances.name: Khayyal
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review: 'typically persisting for 5 to 8 hours'; sillage and projection moderate. Spring, summer and fall best; suits a full workday.

fragrances.name: Larimar
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review: longevity described only as 'moderate', with no hour figure; sillage moderate, projecting at arm's length. Spring and fall best, summer and winter acceptable.

fragrances.name: Last Swim

sources.name: Vivir — Maison Asrar Last Swim review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review: '7-8 hours of consistent presence'; projection above average, sillage 'strong'. Spring and summer best, fall acceptable, winter to avoid; daytime wear.

fragrances.name: Legacy

sources.name: The Scent Base — Maison Asrar Legacy

fragrances.performanceEvidence: The Scent Base community rating: longevity 'Above Average' with 6+ hours. One Parfumo reviewer scored longevity 6/10; no sillage level is stated.

fragrances.name: Librae
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review: 'approximately 5-7 hours on skin'; sillage moderate, projection moderate to intimate. Fall and winter best, spring and summer OK; good for office and daily wear.

fragrances.name: Luna

sources.name: The Scent Base — Maison Asrar Luna

fragrances.performanceEvidence: The Scent Base listing states 'long lasting 8+ hours', but the listing had no user reviews yet, so the figure is unconfirmed.

fragrances.name: Magic Night

sources.name: Vivir — Maison Asrar Magic Night review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review: 'a solid 6-8 hours of wear'; sillage moderate, projection moderate to strong at first. Fall and winter best, spring OK, summer to avoid; suits date nights and evenings.

fragrances.name: Majesty

sources.name: The Scent Base — Maison Asrar Majesty

fragrances.performanceEvidence: The Scent Base community data: 'above average 6+ hours' longevity and intimate projection. A Parfumo user says it fades to a skin scent after a few hours, so the level is a tendency.

fragrances.name: Masterpiece

sources.name: The Scent Base — Maison Asrar Masterpiece

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Search summary of The Scent Base: longevity around 6-10 hours, and sillage described as modest. Parfumo community ratings (about 7.6/10 for both) are not turned into a level.

fragrances.name: Mohra
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review: '12-plus hours on skin; longer on fabric'; sillage 'very strong' and heavy, so sprays should be few. Cool-weather evening wear.

fragrances.name: Muharib
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Search summary of Scentverdict: longevity roughly 6-10 hours and projection strong; best season fall and winter. Parfumo community data calls projection and longevity above average.

fragrances.name: Oh Honey!
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scentverdict lists longevity as moderate (4-6 h) and projection as moderate. Parfumo and brand claims of a full day are not used, as they are community or marketing statements.

fragrances.name: Petra
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review: sillage 'moderate to strong'; the 8+ hour longevity is a brand claim the review did not verify, so longevity is left empty. Good for fall and winter evenings.

fragrances.name: Regent
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review: longevity 'typically hovers around 5-6 hours', some wearers 6-8+; sillage strong in the first 1-2 hours, then moderate projection. Spring and summer best, fall OK, winter to avoid.

fragrances.name: Rubellite
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review: '4-6 hours on skin'; sillage moderate to strong for the first two hours, then close to skin. Fall and winter best; evening and cold-weather wear.

fragrances.name: Silent Surge

sources.name: Vivir — Maison Asrar Silent Surge review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review: '~7 hours on skin'; sillage and projection moderate (about 50 cm), stronger in the first 1-2 hours. Spring and summer best, fall OK, winter to avoid.

fragrances.name: Sunset in Capri

sources.name: The Scent Base — Maison Asrar Sunset in Capri

fragrances.performanceEvidence: The Scent Base listing: wear time '6+ hours' and projection described as above average. No sillage level is stated; based on the listing alone.

fragrances.name: Throne Eclipse

sources.name: Vivir — Maison Asrar Throne Eclipse review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review: '6-8 hours' longevity; projection and sillage both moderate. Fall and winter best, spring OK, summer to avoid; suits evenings.

fragrances.name: Turath Malaki

sources.name: The Scent Base — Maison Asrar Turath Malaki

fragrances.performanceEvidence: The Scent Base community data: 6+ hours longevity and strong projection (few ratings). Fragplace lists the top, heart and base notes. The Scent Base also calls it fresh, spicy, woody and citrus.

fragrances.name: Vanguard
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review: 'eight-plus hours routinely' on skin and fabric; sillage 'strong', leaves a visible trail. Fall and winter best, spring OK, summer to avoid; suits evenings.

fragrances.name: Veyra
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review: '5-8 hours'; sillage moderate to strong, projection strong for the first 1-2 hours. Spring and summer daily wear; not recommended for winter.
